row.Finding: Bambu PA6-CF will experience a decrease in strength and stiffness after absorbing water, making it not recommended for printing models with high requirements for strength, stiffness, and dimensional stability, especially thin and elongated models. The prints of PA6-CF usually become tougher and more resistant to impacts, drops, and collisions when they get damp; you can dampen and soften the prints in advance if the model requires high toughness.
row.Exposure / conditions: Maker explicitly describes moisture tradeoff; quantitative dry/wet TDS specimens remain controlling, not a universal condition or service test.
